messages:
noah: Quick accessibility sweep results from the Console prototype demo (NVDA+Firefox). Dropping short actionable items so we can prioritize.

sana: thanks! which screens?

noah: model list + quick actions, header hamburger, and streaming toast: 
• Streaming toast floods aria-live with token updates -> NVDA interrupts users. Recommend single summary announcements only.
• Hamburger menu: Esc closes but focus doesn't return to the trigger -> focus loss.
• Quick-action tiles implemented as div[role=button] without tabindex or keyboard focus visible.
• Small CTA in dark theme fails contrast at 12px (around 3.3:1).

ben: plan: 1) change streaming to visually update per-token but only announce end-of-stream via role=status 2) ensure menu close calls triggerButton.focus() and add e2e keyboard test 3) convert tile divs to <button> and add focus-visible styles 4) bump primary token so it meets 4.5:1 or increase label weight.

ux_maya: design ok with subtle 1px outline on small bars instead of darkening fill. tooltip copy: change "Copy" to "Copy model ID" for SR context.

a11y-bot: Automated scan: 5 issues found (2 high: live-region flooding, focus restore; 3 medium: interactive semantics, contrast, missing aria-hidden on decorative svgs). Report: /internal/a11y/reports/1901234567

noah: prioritizing live-region and focus restore P0. Ben, can you open PRs and tag me for quick review?

ben: will do, aiming to link PRs by EOD.

noah: i'll re-test with NVDA after merges and drop a one-line verification. thanks all :sparkles:
